name: print-social-ad-fitness-red-circle-photo-offer
title: White/red fitness ad with circular photo frame and offer badge
whatItIs: A clean white square ad for a gym, featuring a circular dotted-border photo of a woman training, a bold 'Find Your Strength' headline, a red circular '50% off' pedestal badge, and a bulleted feature list.
whatItMeans: A dotted circular photo frame plus a matching circular offer badge creates two visual anchors of the same shape, giving an otherwise text-heavy layout a sense of intentional geometry.
techniques: frame a portrait photo in a dotted-outline circle rather than a plain rectangle
repeat the circle motif in a separate offer badge to tie two focal points together visually
use a bold accent color (red) sparingly for only the offer and key headline word for hierarchy

vocabulary.definition: a frame made of small repeated dots rather than a solid line, giving a lighter, more textured edge
